notes: Generated by vectorize.py, which reads the reference: objects from hand-drawn regions plus colour rules, per-object shading clusters (RGB k-means), every region of 4+ px traced at 2x as one part, stacked over gradient-filled object silhouettes, half-pixel-corrected geometry with self-coloured strokes, and a colour refit from an ownership render. No blur, no byte limit. Paths are grouped object > material > shade > part; viewer.html inspects them. Needs opencv-python-headless.
